issues.reason: The half that stands is (Possession patrick_pelloux association_of_emergency_doctors): it is the appositive's own of-complement, and *Tense / modality over a copular clause* says a past host wraps every categorical atom the clause yields — "any PartOf the clause asserts alike" — so it must take the same Past wrapper its typing atom already has; the half that overstates is statement 4, (Possession association_of_emergency_doctors france), which is a standing identifying relation of the named organization, on the same footing as its unflagged (Member … association) kind atom rather than a predication the reporting clause makes.

gaps_confirmed: Direct quoted speech as a reporting verb's complement ("'This is unacceptable,' said X"): *Propositional attitudes* licenses only a finite that-clause, so nothing records that the proposition was quoted verbatim.
A discourse-deictic demonstrative pronoun ("This") pointing outside the sentence: the no-antecedent pronoun rules enumerate only he/she/they/it.
new_gaps: Whether a genitive inside a referring expression for a proper-noun entity ("France's Association …") counts as an atom "the clause yields" for the past-tense wrapper, or as a standing identifying fact like the entity's kind atom.
repair_summary: Wrapped the appositive's of-complement as (Past (Possession patrick_pelloux association_of_emergency_doctors)) so it carries the host clause's tense alongside the appositive typing atom; left (Possession association_of_emergency_doctors france) and (Member association_of_emergency_doctors association) untensed as identifying facts of the named organization.
notes: Experiencer on say is licensed (say is listed non-factive), the sealed complement is correctly not asserted at top level, and the antecedent-less "This" correctly takes a thing-classed witness whose typing projects out of the seal.
